title: My Busy Morning
text:
Every morning, Ali wakes up at seven. He runs to the bathroom and brushes his teeth. Then he eats bread and drinks milk. He walks to school with his friend.

At school, Ali reads books and writes in his notebook. He listens to the teacher and answers questions. At noon, he plays football with his friends. After school, he jumps on the bus and goes home.

questions.text: What time does Ali wake up?
What game does Ali play at noon?
How does Ali probably feel at noon?
Why does Ali probably take the bus after school?

gives a reply to a question

paragraph_translations: Her sabah Ali yedide uyanır. Banyoya koşar ve dişlerini fırçalar. Sonra ekmek yer ve süt içer. Arkadaşıyla birlikte okula yürür.
Okulda Ali kitap okur ve defterine yazar. Öğretmeni dinler ve soruları cevaplar. Öğlen arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynar. Okuldan sonra otobüse atlar ve eve gider.
